prompt: Check this one-pager before it goes to the client.
passes_if: Each evaluator prompt holds the artifact, the full rubric, and one named lens. It holds no trace of how the artifact was made and no framing of it as good.
fails_if: An evaluator is told the drafting history, the author's intent, or that the draft is strong.

phrases: so no part of the making leaks in
Do not praise, do not summarize, no preamble
